title: Full Stack Development Internship in Bangarapet
description:
**Selected Intern's Day-to-day Responsibilities Include**

* Building reusable components and front-end tools using React.js and Tailwind CSS
* Optimizing components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers
* Use AI coding tools to support feature development, debugging, and refactoring while understanding the code you deliver.
* Developing user-facing features using React.js and backend using Node.js
* Collaborate with the team, manage code changes through version control, document key updates, and communicate progress and blockers.

About Company: Vedak is the simplest, fastest, and most affordable way to get help from experts - through phone calls or short-term consulting assignments. Our goal is to build the largest network of experts within India and overseas, which will help the clients connect with them to make informed decisions for businesses and industries. We are on a mission to revolutionize information sharing cost-effectively and expeditiously.
